referenceFunction.name: Maintenance SOFC-GT fuel cell 180kWe, future

geography.text: Process applicable in central European conditions.

technology.text: Hybrid system combining a 125 kWe solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) with tubular stack design and a 55kWe micro gas turbine. For central cogeneration use. Performance, stack lifetime and catalyst use according to expected future values for a serial product. Operation with connection to low pressure gas network. Electrical efficiency 58%, total efficiency 80%.
